limits: Static independent review only; root owns integrated execution checks. No fresh conformance, stress, allocation-failure or wall-time verdict is inferred from this review.
Checked query and cursor correctness relies on an unmodified parser-produced document; the application satisfies this condition. Forged or mutated raw tapes are outside its input boundary.

checked_request has a defensive query-error return that execute currently discards. It is unreachable for valid parser-produced cursor state; this review does not establish behavior after a future library invariant violation.

Repeated-pin validation now uses indexed checked queries inside a bounded pair scan; worst-case schema cost can increase. The32-pin bound is preserved, but this review does not certify the largest64-board runtime budget.
Validated report geometry, sorting and connectivity still use raw document descriptors and existing std_order APIs; this is a schema migration, not a total document abstraction migration.
